Base page surface: the page itself and parts that sit flat on it, such as chat list rows and the chat navbar. Surfaces are numbered by distance from the base. A card, banner or other part that sits on top uses surface-raised.
One step from the base: hover fills on surface-100 and quiet containers. For an area set into the page, use surface-sunken.
Two steps from the base: hover on surface-200, tracks and pressed fills.
Three steps from the base: hover on surface-300 and deeper nested fills.
Four steps from the base, for rare deeply nested fills.
Stronger decorative borders, such as uncolored Notification and Banner outlines.
Default border and divider color for cards, rows and frames.
Faintest border. Reserved; not used by any component yet.
Default text color for headings, labels and body copy on page surfaces.
Secondary text: descriptions, helper text, metadata and unselected labels.
Disabled text and placeholders that do not need to meet contrast targets.
